unit.title: ADT split test: 'book a free survey' vs 'get a free quote'

claim.quote: So, what they did is they tested book a free survey against get a free quote. Those were the two options. So, the only difference was the wording. Now, which do you think won? But what you've got to think about is what's the perceived pain of getting that survey? What's the perceived pain? What's the perceived risk?
